During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] launched an '''attack''' on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pkihantri Rebel base|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pkihantri]]. The Empire used a [[Unidentified SB-20 Slicer Droid|SB-20 Slicer Droid]] to gather information before executing the assault.<ref name="GFT" />
